# Germany's road from Totaler Sieg to the civil war: the mechanics the focuses
# generated by tools/gen_ger_road_to_civil_war.py call. All in German scope
# unless a comment says otherwise.
#
# The zz_ file name sorts after wif_ger_road_auto.txt, wif_ger_speer.txt and
# GER_scripted_effects.txt on purpose: scripted effects are read in file
# order, and these call effects defined in all three.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Army-SS distrust, 0-100. Counts quietly from Totaler Sieg; shown in The Reich
# Divided once The Generals Count Their Divisions completes. At 100 the army
# moves (wif_ger_road.5), unless SS Liaison Officers in Every Corps was taken.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

wif_ger_check_army_moves = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { wif_ger_distrust > 99.9 }
			has_completed_focus = GER_offer_retirement
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = GER_germany_on_the_brink }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_liaison_officers }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_army_moved }
			wif_ger_hitler_rules = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = wif_ger_army_moved
		country_event = { id = wif_ger_road.5 days = 1 }
	}
}

# Adds the temp variable wif_dist (may be negative). After The Army Waits it
# can no longer fall.
wif_ger_add_distrust = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = wif_ger_army_waits
			check_variable = { wif_dist < 0 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wif_dist = 0 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { wif_ger_distrust = wif_dist }
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_ger_distrust min = 0 max = 100 }
	wif_ger_check_army_moves = yes
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Focus effects
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# A Guard of His Own: six Leibstandarte divisions in Berlin. Built like the
# Waffen SS template: locked, so it cannot be edited or trained.
wif_ger_create_leibstandarte_template = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Leibstandarte Division" } }
		division_template = {
			name = "Leibstandarte Division"
			priority = 2
			division_names_group = WIF_GER_SS_MIL
			is_locked = yes
			override_model = GER_militia
			regiments = {
				militia = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				militia = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				militia = { x = 0 y = 2 }
				militia = { x = 1 y = 0 }
				militia = { x = 1 y = 1 }
				militia = { x = 1 y = 2 }
				militia = { x = 2 y = 0 }
				militia = { x = 2 y = 1 }
				militia = { x = 2 y = 2 }
				artillery_brigade = { x = 3 y = 0 }
			}
			support = {
				artillery = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				anti_tank = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				anti_air = { x = 0 y = 2 }
				recon = { x = 0 y = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
}

wif_ger_raise_the_fuhrers_guard = {
	set_technology = { militia_tech = 1 popup = no }
	wif_ger_create_leibstandarte_template = yes
	# create_unit needs state scope, never country scope.
	random_owned_state = {
		prioritize = { 64 }
		create_unit = {
			division = "division_template = \"Leibstandarte Division\" start_experience_factor = 1 start_equipment_factor = 1.0"
			owner = GER
			count = 6
		}
	}
}

# The Meuse Border: level 3 forts along the border of every German state that
# touches the Ordensstaat Burgund.
wif_ger_fortify_burgund_border = {
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = {
			any_neighbor_state = { is_owned_by = OSB }
		}
		add_building_construction = {
			type = bunker
			level = 3
			instant_build = yes
			province = {
				all_provinces = yes
				limit_to_border = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Tribute from the Order State: a tenth of Burgund's rifles, once a year, for
# as long as it is a German subject.
wif_ger_osb_pay_tribute = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = OSB
			OSB = { is_subject_of = GER }
		}
		OSB = {
			set_temp_variable = { wif_tribute = num_equipment@infantry_equipment }
			multiply_temp_variable = { wif_tribute = 0.1 }
			round_temp_variable = wif_tribute
			set_temp_variable = { wif_tribute_neg = wif_tribute }
			multiply_temp_variable = { wif_tribute_neg = -1 }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = var:wif_tribute_neg }
		}
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = var:wif_tribute producer = OSB }
		set_country_flag = { flag = wif_ger_osb_tribute_paid days = 365 value = 1 }
	}
}

# Demobilise the Reserves: up to 20 infantry divisions go home. destroy_unit
# refunds nothing, so the men and their rifles are handed back by count.
wif_ger_demobilise_reserves = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_demob = num_divisions }
	every_country_division = {
		random_select_amount = 20
		limit = { division_has_majority_template = infantry }
		destroy_unit = yes
	}
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_demob = num_divisions }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_demob_men = wif_demob }
	multiply_temp_variable = { wif_demob_men = 9000 }
	add_manpower = var:wif_demob_men
	set_temp_variable = { wif_demob_rifles = wif_demob }
	multiply_temp_variable = { wif_demob_rifles = 900 }
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = var:wif_demob_rifles }
}

# Speer Resigns: he leaves the Inner Circle (GER_remove_speer_effects empties
# his seat), his ministry's spirit goes, and his faction's support is shared
# out between the other three.
wif_ger_speer_resigns = {
	if = {
		limit = { wif_ger_speer_in_inner_circle = yes }
		GER_remove_speer_effects = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_ger_speer_economy_modifier } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_ger_speer_economy_modifier }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_succession_contest }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_sc_share = wif_ger_sc_economy }
		divide_temp_variable = { wif_sc_share = 3 }
		add_to_variable = { wif_ger_sc_party = wif_sc_share }
		add_to_variable = { wif_ger_sc_propaganda = wif_sc_share }
		add_to_variable = { wif_ger_sc_luftwaffe = wif_sc_share }
		set_variable = { wif_ger_sc_economy = 0 }
	}
	set_country_flag = wif_ger_speer_resigned
}

# New Names for Old Cities.
wif_ger_new_names_for_old_cities = {
	set_province_name = { id = 9508 name = "Litzmannstadt" }
	set_province_name = { id = 9263 name = "Gotenhafen" }
	set_province_name = { id = 6558 name = "Posen" }
	set_province_name = { id = 6464 name = "Kattowitz" }
	set_province_name = { id = 3230 name = "Schröttersburg" }
}

# The Wartheland Model: Poznan (86) and Lodz (87), if German, get two civilian
# factories and a level of infrastructure; every annexed German state builds
# 10% faster for a year.
wif_ger_wartheland_model = {
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			OR = { state = 86 state = 87 }
			is_owned_by = GER
		}
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2
		add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 2 instant_build = yes }
		add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
	}
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = { wif_ger_is_annexed_state = yes }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_ger_wartheland_construction days = 365 }
	}
}

# Blood Before Labour: every annexed German state loses another 15% of its
# population. Worked in thousands, in the state's own scope, like
# wif_ger_purify_state_population.
wif_ger_blood_before_labour = {
	every_owned_state = {
		limit = { wif_ger_is_annexed_state = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_purge = state_population_k }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_purge = -150 } # thousands -> people, x0.15
		add_manpower = var:wif_purge
	}
}

# Fuhrer Found Dead: Hitler is gone, and until the Party agrees on a successor
# the Reichstag governs.
wif_ger_fuhrer_found_dead = {
	set_country_flag = wif_ger_fuhrer_dead
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = wif_ger_visibly_aging_fuhrer }
		remove_ideas = wif_ger_visibly_aging_fuhrer
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = wif_ger_second_stroke }
		remove_ideas = wif_ger_second_stroke
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = wif_ger_berghof_court }
		remove_ideas = wif_ger_berghof_court
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = wif_ger_government_by_audience }
		remove_ideas = wif_ger_government_by_audience
	}
	recruit_character = wif_ger_reichstag
	add_country_leader_role = {
		character = wif_ger_reichstag
		promote_leader = yes
		country_leader = {
			ideology = nazism
			traits = { wif_ger_paralysed_government }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_character = GER_adolf_hitler }
		retire_character = GER_adolf_hitler
	}
	every_country = {
		news_event = { id = wif_ger_road.6 }
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Once a month, from on_monthly_GER.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
wif_ger_road_monthly = {
	# The Army Waits: +2 a month while the Fuhrer's guard exists.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = wif_ger_army_waits
			wif_ger_hitler_rules = yes
			OR = {
				has_idea = wif_ger_the_fuhrers_guard
				has_idea = wif_ger_the_fuhrers_guard_2
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wif_dist = 2 }
		wif_ger_add_distrust = yes
	}

	# The succession contest: each faction gains 0-3 support a month. Speer's
	# only while he sits in the Inner Circle.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = wif_ger_succession_contest
			wif_ger_hitler_rules = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = wif_sc_roll min = 0 max = 3 integer = yes }
		add_to_variable = { wif_ger_sc_party = wif_sc_roll }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = wif_sc_roll min = 0 max = 3 integer = yes }
		add_to_variable = { wif_ger_sc_propaganda = wif_sc_roll }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = wif_sc_roll min = 0 max = 3 integer = yes }
		add_to_variable = { wif_ger_sc_luftwaffe = wif_sc_roll }
		if = {
			limit = { wif_ger_speer_in_inner_circle = yes }
			set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = wif_sc_roll min = 0 max = 3 integer = yes }
			add_to_variable = { wif_ger_sc_economy = wif_sc_roll }
		}
	}

	# Dr Morell's Injections: one month in four, the Fuhrer overrules someone.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = wif_ger_morell
			wif_ger_hitler_rules = yes
		}
		random = {
			chance = 25
			country_event = { id = wif_ger_road.1 days = 1 random_days = 20 }
		}
	}

	# Tribute from the Order State, once a year.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = wif_ger_osb_tribute
			NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_osb_tribute_paid }
		}
		wif_ger_osb_pay_tribute = yes
	}

	wif_ger_road_try_all = yes
}
